dynamic_rules.description: Avoid entering trades in weak momentum conditions unless there is clear institutional absorption or delta confirmation at the entry point. Weak momentum increases the risk of stop runs.

dynamic_rules.topic: Trade Entry in High Delta Conditions
dynamic_rules.description: Avoid entering trades when delta is excessively high (> 500) without clear institutional absorption. High delta conditions often lead to reversals and stop runs.

session_learnings: High delta conditions near key levels led to reversals and stop runs, confirming the need for rules AMT_NEW_40 and AMT_NEW_52.
Trades entered in weak momentum conditions without clear institutional absorption resulted in stop runs, reinforcing the validity of rule AMT_NEW_34.
Developing trends without confirmation of institutional absorption or delta divergence were susceptible to reversals, highlighting the importance of rules AMT_NEW_45 and AMT_NEW_47.
